name: Coffee Fiel - Kiaf SEOUL 2026 Pop Up
drink: Ethiopia Gedeb Halo Hartume G1 Washed - Iced
note: Ethiopia Gedeb Halo Hartume G1 Washed - Iced Had this iced hand drip on my trip to the Kiaf Art Festival. Very bright acidity and clean aftertaste. I thought I would get more of the nutty, Ethiopia flavor that I could smell from the Aroma Display, but still could taste it. Good balance.

name: Cafe Marie
address: 45 Apgujeong-ro 34-gil, Gangnam District, Seoul, South Korea
note: Cafe Latte Ristretto - Hot Warm, nutty, great mouthfeel and somehow tastes better because I know the guy behind the drink. It’s as I remembered it from before my US trip. Awesome latte.

name: Devoción
address: 142 Grand Street, Brooklyn, Kings County, New York
note: Special Drip They are known for only using Columbian sourced beans for all of their blends. Overall, the coffee was not bad, but I’m so sad because I got there 10 minutes before closing and they ran out of the pour over I wanted. The barista felt bad and gave me their drip for free, but it wasn’t mind-blowing or anything. Big asterisk on the rating on this one since I didn’t get their signatures, so I’ll definitely have to come back for some of their better house blends.

name: Bean Monger Coffee Tavern
address: 608 Union Street, Brooklyn, Kings County, New York
note: Latte This was just incredible. I got their salted chocolate chip cookie with their latte, and the pairing was amazing. The overall vibe of the place was so cozy and warm too. I would definitely revisit if I’m in Brooklyn

name: Fellini Coffee
address: 120 Thompson Street, Manhattan, New York County, New York
note: Iced Dolce Vita I usually don’t order sweet coffee but this was very very good. The caramel syrup goes so well with the espresso- toasty and sweet. Would come again.

name: Oslo Coffee Roasters
note: Iced Americano - Odin Blend (Brazil-Sumatra-Guatemala-Kenya) Americano had a very distinct acidity that was surprisingly very fruity, overall good balance. I really liked the interior too

name: 787 Coffee
address: 202 West 10th Street, Manhattan, New York County, New York
drink: Iced Latte - Puerto Rico Rum Infused Beans
note: Iced Latte - Puerto Rico Rum Infused Beans I loved that they gave the coffee in a pouch! The latte tasted great, nothing too special, but cinnamon-like and good balance. Slightly pricey though, but that’s just Manhattan. Had a great chat with the barista there, she was very sweet explaining all their bean varieties as I shared my experience touring NYC

name: La Cabra on Laffayette Street
address: 284 Lafayette Street, Manhattan, New York County, New York
note: Bit too diluted for my liking, the aroma is floral and clean. Got a bit bitter toward the end of my drink, and drip coffee was $15 with tax, pretty overpriced imo

name: MOKAFÉ Coffee House
address: 687 8th Avenue, Manhattan, New York County, New York
note: Very standard iced latte, ordered it with whole milk. Quite pricey though, but that’s Manhattan for you

name: Marah Coffee Roasters
note: 2-storey coffee roaster house in Giheung, peaceful countryside view run by amazingly heartwarming people. I got to try pouring their Ethiopian Kochere Natural, clean with smooth acidic aftertaste. Interviewed the owner over coffee franchise gentrification in Korea for a documentary!

name: Heo Coffee (허형만의 압구정커피집)
address: 151 Apgujeong-ro, Gangnam District, Seoul, South Korea
note: Striked a conversation with the owner over how to get consistent pours. She told me to try pouring myself a cup, and corrected my pouring technique to be more steady and slower.

name: Heo Coffee (허형만의 압구정커피집)
address: 151 Apgujeong-ro, Gangnam District, Seoul, South Korea
note: Owner recognized me as I walked in lol. Asked him for a new single variety to try, and he recommended me this. Nice balance, the flavors are a bit heavier than Costa Rica last time, hits mid-back of my mouth. Really solid, would try again.

name: Cafe Marie
address: 45 Apgujeong-ro 34-gil, Gangnam District, Seoul, South Korea
note: Very toasty, sweet, and super clean with no bitter aftertaste. One of best lattes I’ve had in a while. Really soothing latte on a rainy day. The owner is really sweet and passionate about his coffee craft. He uses quality beans for his espressos (loves Yemen Mocha Mattari), and roasts his own blends daily in the backroom of the shop. He was so kind in explaining a single shot and a ristretto. I had a wonderful conversation with him! Definitely would visit again.

name: Hit Coffee Roasters
address: 554-32 Sinsa-dong, Gangnam District, Seoul, South Korea
note: The cafe has a very cool concept of focusing on interesting roasts, like grape or peach aromas. These notes are very accentuated in the beans—I got the chance to smell them, and they are exactly like the fruits labeled on them. So cool! I just don’t think their Kenya was for me, so I will definitely come back to try their other varieties or just an espresso.

name: Heo Coffee (허형만의 압구정커피집)
address: 151 Apgujeong-ro, Gangnam District, Seoul, South Korea
note: Coffee goes down super smooth, and the after taste is so clean. I had a wonderful conversation with the coffeeshop owner. Heo’s Coffee has a rich 25-year history as a family-run business, and he was the son of his father who started the shop. They roast their beans every day and it is excellent quality—I can feel his love for coffee in his voice. Definitely recommend!!

name: Marklane Coffee Roasters
address: 23-5 Seolleung-ro 157-gil, Gangnam District, Seoul, South Korea
note: Had a very nice conversation with Marklane’s owner—what started as a hobby is now his 10+ years-long business. I shared with him my experience dripping coffee at home, experimenting etc. As a note for his pour technique: he stirs the coffee grounds after the first bloom pour for an even extraction.

name: Bunker Company (벙커컴퍼니)
address: 23 Eonju-ro 167-gil, Gangnam District, Seoul, South Korea
note: Asked for sweet brew option over acidity. Coffee mouthfeel was a bit too heavy, but nevertheless had very interesting rustic fruity taste. The atmosphere of the cafe is really cool. It has a dark, sophisticated interior with a cozy and elegant vibe.
